scope: One safe carryless-multiplication CRC primitive; complete warm PNG16 then affected PNG8 decode and PNG8 encode. Same two original 513x259 rasters, three pairs maximum, no new images or quality enumeration.
changedPrimitive: Fold normal-order CRC polynomials in 16-byte blocks with two PCLMUL operations; derive x^64/x^128/x^192 remainders and polynomial Barrett quotient from the PNG polynomial. Reverse input bits within each byte with safe SSE2; bounded big-endian scalar span reads, value vectors, scalar eight-byte and byte tails/fallback. No unsafe/native code, dependencies or copied upstream tables.

cpuProfileBeforeChange.scope: One current retained PNG Decode16 warm CPU profile; workload loops include warmup/calibration. Not parity timing.
cpuProfileBeforeChange.attributionRule: Exact method names before parentheses exclude parameter types. Inclusive methods overlap and cannot be added. The last visible frame may include inlined work or unattributed native transitions; it is not a pure managed-only cost.

Inclusive CPU methods overlap; warmup/calibration included. The CPU profile supplies attribution, not parity timing.
PNG16 means straddle 2x and PNG8 remains above 2x. Other provisional, unknown and unmatched required paths remain open.
BDN allocation estimates are retained verbatim; fixed-count complete decode allocation checks compare actual packages without timing.
